graph.name: christmas-bell-esp32tht
graph.description: Automatic Christmas bell, variant ESP32 THT (D-23): the circuit of the variant ESP32 – a LILYGO T-Display V1.1 (ESP32, 1.14 inch TFT) instead of the Nano, 3.3 V logic, yellow-green LEDs (D-13, D-14) – with through-hole parts only and no assembly, like the variant THT (D-12): a bare board to solder by hand.

purpose.notes: Automatic Christmas bell, ESP32 THT variant, for the owner's home, built and used by the owner – not sold or given away (D-16). Powered through the T-Display's USB-C only – no cell at the module's battery input, no mains. The T-Display's ESP32 uses Wi-Fi (2.4 GHz, channels 1-13): a web page in the owner's home network – status and control of the countdown, no internet service – and a setup hotspot (WPA2) until the home network is set (D-17); Bluetooth stays off.

U1.notes: Wi-Fi channels 1-13 only: the firmware variants/esp32/firmware sets country DE with 802.11d off at every Wi-Fi start (D-13, D-17); Bluetooth is never started; the default power limit

conventions.pin_reference: '<designator>.<pin>' with the pin's name or role, else its symbol number – the parts entry says which pin that is
conventions.v: per net: [min, max] in V over all operating states
conventions.accept: per net or component: {code: reason} accepts a finding on purpose (edakit explain <code>)

components.label: LILYGO T-Display V1.1 (plugged in)
components.notes: Plugs into two 1x12 female headers KH-2.54FH-1X12P-H8.5 (C2905419), pitch 2.54 mm, rows 22.86 mm apart (hand-soldered, [[extra]] in edakit.toml). Powered through its USB-C socket; its 5V pin (VBUS behind the module's 1N5819) supplies the servo and C1, its 3V3 pin (AP2112K) the buttons. Strapping pins IO12/IO15/IO2 and the second 3V3 pin stay free. LCSC C18722937 is a stand-in for the EasyEDA device: its symbol and footprint are rebuilt in the project (D-13).

components.label: Servo (GND, +5 V, signal)
components.notes: Standard servo plug: brown = GND (1), red = +5 V (2), orange = signal (3). THT header as on the variant THT (D-12).

components.label: Buffer capacitor for the servo
components.notes: Absorbs the servo's start-up peaks so the ESP32 does not reset. THT radial Ø10 × 13 mm as on the variant THT (D-12).

components.label: 5 mm LED, yellow-green, countdown step 1
components.notes: D-23: yellow-green as on the variant ESP32 (D-14) – the 3.3 V outputs do not drive a 3 V green evenly; XL-504SYGD, VF 2.0–2.6 V at 20 mA

components.label: Series resistor LED5
components.notes: D-23: 100 Ω as on the variant ESP32 (D-14) – the yellow-green XL-504SYGD at full current

components.label: 5 mm LED, yellow-green, countdown step 2
components.notes: D-23: yellow-green as on the variant ESP32 (D-14) – the 3.3 V outputs do not drive a 3 V green evenly; XL-504SYGD, VF 2.0–2.6 V at 20 mA

components.label: Series resistor LED4
components.notes: D-23: 100 Ω as on the variant ESP32 (D-14) – the yellow-green XL-504SYGD at full current

components.label: 5 mm LED, yellow, countdown step 3
components.notes: As on the variant THT: pin 2 = anode, the footprint's "+" at pad 2

components.label: Series resistor LED3
components.notes: D-23: 330 Ω – red and yellow dimmed to the yellow-green's brightness (owner's decision): XL-504SURD/UYD give 400–900 mcd at 20 mA, the XL-504SYGD 50–200 mcd

components.label: 5 mm LED, yellow, countdown step 4
components.notes: As on the variant THT: pin 2 = anode, the footprint's "+" at pad 2

components.label: Series resistor LED2
components.notes: D-23: 330 Ω – red and yellow dimmed to the yellow-green's brightness (owner's decision): XL-504SURD/UYD give 400–900 mcd at 20 mA, the XL-504SYGD 50–200 mcd

components.label: 5 mm LED, red, countdown step 5
components.notes: As on the variant THT: the footprint marks pad 1 as anode (+) – symbol name K, role anode (parts entry)

components.label: Series resistor LED1
components.notes: D-23: 330 Ω – red and yellow dimmed to the yellow-green's brightness (owner's decision): XL-504SURD/UYD give 400–900 mcd at 20 mA, the XL-504SYGD 50–200 mcd

components.label: Start button
components.notes: 1/2 and 3/4 are connected inside the button.

components.label: Reset button
components.notes: 1/2 and 3/4 are connected inside the button.

components.label: Base load for USB power banks (R8 ∥ R9 = 50 Ω, 100 mA)
components.notes: Keeps a power bank from switching off (D-8): the module alone draws at least 0.04 A (i_core_min_a), with the base load R8 ∥ R9 the board at least about 0.14 A (simulated).

components.label: Base load for USB power banks (R8 ∥ R9 = 50 Ω, 100 mA)
components.notes: Keeps a power bank from switching off (D-8): the module alone draws at least 0.04 A (i_core_min_a), with the base load R8 ∥ R9 the board at least about 0.14 A (simulated).

nets.name: +5V
nets.notes: 5V pin of the T-Display: USB VBUS behind the module's 1N5819; supplies the servo and C1.

nets.name: +3V3
nets.notes: 3V3 pin of the T-Display (AP2112K-3.3); switched to the inputs by the buttons (D-13).

nets.name: SERVO
nets.notes: IO13, 3.3 V PWM into the servo's signal input (D-13).

nets.name: BTN_START
nets.notes: Pressed = 3.3 V at IO38 (input only), else R7 pulls to GND (D-13).

nets.name: BTN_RESET
nets.notes: Pressed = 3.3 V at IO37 (input only), else R6 pulls to GND (D-13).

accept.HINT.bulk: C1 1000 µF / 16 V electrolytic on +5V, next to J1 (it buffers the module's 5V pin)
accept.HINT.debounce: debounced in the ESP32 firmware variants/esp32/firmware like buttons.ino (50 ms, D-17) – the same firmware runs on this board
accept.HINT.esd: J1 is the servo's own cable inside the bell's frame, plugged once; no TVS – like the main board

notes: LED5, LED4, LED3, LED2, LED1 form the countdown row, in this order from left to right, as on every board; their anodes on one side (the footprints differ: LED1's "+" at pad 1, LED2-LED5's anode at pad 2).
U1 plugs into two 1x12 female headers 22.86 mm apart, display up, USB-C at the board edge; mark its 5V pin (U1.1) on the silkscreen – the pin field is symmetric.
R8 and R9 dissipate 0.25 W each: apart from each other and from C1; the builder lets them stand 1-2 mm above the board.
LED4 and LED5 (footprint LED-TH_BD5.9-P2.54-RD_GREEN) show only the flat at the cathode, no "+" and no square pad.
